meta.what: THE mold library — single machine-readable source of truth for thread formats. Merges what used to live in two places that did not know about each other: docs/thread-molds.md (prose, conversion-gated) and the skeleton library's view-gated notion of 'proven'. Loaded by checks.mjs (moldById / provenMolds); docs/thread-molds.md remains the human companion and cites these ids.
meta.how_to_edit: Operator edits directly, or the promotion pipeline (learn.mjs) flips status experimental -> proven when a mold's realized revenue per 1k views clears promote_rev_per_1k over min_posts. Status is DATA, never vibes: every proven entry carries the measurement that proved it.
meta.note_thresholds: promote at >= $0.15/1k realized (fleet substance-led average is $0.232, generic $0.040 — the bar sits between them, nearer the winner). demote a proven mold that decays below $0.03/1k (same floor product-audit uses). min_posts stops a single lucky thread promoting a shape.
